# BUG: BUG-20251216-cutoff-time-force-close Cutoff Time Force Close Not Respected
Status: Pending  <!-- Pending | Ready | In Progress | Review | Done -->

## Bug Summary
At the end of the interval (cutoff time), any open positions should be force closed. This rule should apply to both the first interval (9:35) and the cutoff time (e.g., 9:40). Currently, the cutoff time is not respected - positions remain open past the cutoff time instead of being force closed. Additionally, the default cutoff time should be changed from 9:45 to 9:40 as the standard.

## Stakeholder Notes (raw)
This is a new very important bug. Sometimes there's a rule that should be in place, which is at the end of the interval, the candle has a force close at the end of the interval position. And so this should apply both to the first interval as well as the cutoff time. So I will send you a link to a cutoff time at 9:40, which was not respected. And as a secondary adjacent item, I would like to move the default cutoff time from 9:45 to 9:40 as default, as that is the standard. I would like for that to load as a default behavior.

http://localhost:3000/backtest/2025-07-09?strategy=strategy12.10.1&pt=38&sl=10&trg=8&candleType=1s&cutoffTime=09%3A40

![Broken Page](tests/results/bug-fixes/BUG-20251216-cutoff-time-force-close-BROKEN.png)

## Expected Behavior
1. **Force Close at Cutoff Time**: When the cutoff time is reached (e.g., 9:40), any open positions should be automatically force closed at the close price of the candle immediately before the cutoff time candle.
2. **Force Close at First Interval (9:35)**: This should already be working (similar to existing "Forced 9:35 Close" logic).
3. **Default Cutoff Time**: The default cutoff time should be 9:40 instead of 9:45.

## Observed Behavior
1. **Cutoff Time Not Respected**: When cutoff time is set to 9:40, positions remain open past 9:40 instead of being force closed. The last trade in the example shows an "Open Long" at 09:35:10 ET, but no corresponding "Close Long" entry at or after 9:40.
2. **Default Cutoff Time**: Currently defaults to 9:45 instead of the desired 9:40.

## Repro Steps
1. Navigate to: `http://localhost:3000/backtest/2025-07-09?strategy=strategy12.10.1&pt=38&sl=10&trg=8&candleType=1s&cutoffTime=09%3A40`
2. Observe the "Algorithmic Trades" log
3. Note that there's an "Open Long" trade at 09:35:10 ET
4. Observe that there is NO "Close Long" entry at or after 09:40:00 ET
5. The position should have been force closed at 9:40, but it remains open

## Scope / Impact
- **Who is affected**: All users running backtests with cutoff times
- **How often**: Every time a position is open at cutoff time
- **Severity**: High - This violates trading rules and can lead to incorrect backtest results. Positions should not remain open past the cutoff time.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] AC-1: Force close is implemented at cutoff time - any open positions are closed at the close price of the candle immediately before the cutoff time candle.
- [ ] AC-2: Force close at first interval (9:35) continues to work correctly.
- [ ] AC-3: Default cutoff time is changed from 9:45 to 9:40 across all strategies.
- [ ] AC-4: No regressions: relevant unit + e2e tests pass.

## Tests

### E2E Tests
<!-- tests/e2e/ — write stakeholder-clear cases + max 2 "how" bullets -->

### UNIT TESTS
<!-- tests/unit/ — use fixtures in tests/fixtures when data-driven -->

## Tasks
<!-- Two-tier tasks system; top-level tasks must map to ACs -->

- [ ] Task 1: Write failing test(s) that reproduce the bug (AC: AC-1, AC-2)
  - [ ] Subtask 1.1: Add unit test that verifies force close at cutoff time (e.g., 9:40).
  - [ ] Subtask 1.2: Add unit test that verifies force close at 9:35 still works.
  - [ ] Subtask 1.3: Add e2e test that verifies cutoff time force close in UI.
- [ ] Task 2: Implement force close at cutoff time (AC: AC-1)
  - [ ] Subtask 2.1: Add cutoff time check in `scanForExit()` function (similar to 9:35 force close logic).
  - [ ] Subtask 2.2: Ensure force close uses the close price of the candle immediately before cutoff time candle.
- [ ] Task 3: Change default cutoff time from 9:45 to 9:40 (AC: AC-3)
  - [ ] Subtask 3.1: Update default parameter in all strategy functions.
  - [ ] Subtask 3.2: Update UI default value.
- [ ] Task 4: Validate all tests pass + attach evidence (AC: AC-4)
  - [ ] Subtask 4.1: Run unit + e2e suites; write `### Test Evidence` links.

## Dev Notes
- The existing "Forced 9:35 Close" logic in `scanForExit()` can be used as a template for cutoff time force close.
- Need to check `isBeforeCutoff()` function to determine when cutoff time is reached.
- Force close should happen at the close price of the candle immediately before the cutoff time candle (similar to 9:35 logic which uses `candles[i-1].close`).
- Default cutoff time appears in multiple strategy files - need to update all of them.

Perfect! I've successfully made the bug report screenshots viewable in the docs. Here's what I did:

## Changes Made

1. **Created a dedicated directory** for bug screenshots:
   - Created `/src/public/docs/assets/images/bug-screenshots/`

2. **Copied all bug screenshots** from the test results directory to the docs assets:
   - Moved all PNG files from `tests/results/bug-fixes/` to the new docs assets directory

3. **Updated all bug report references** to point to the new location:
   - Updated 4 bug reports that were referencing screenshots with relative paths
   - Changed all `tests/results/bug-fixes/filename.png` references to `/docs/assets/images/bug-screenshots/filename.png`

4. **Rebuilt the docs** to include the new images in the docs site

5. **Committed the changes** with a clear commit message

## Result

Now when you view any bug report in the `/docs` page, the screenshots will display directly inline with the bug report content. The images are properly served by the web server and will load correctly.

You can now see the before/after screenshots directly in the bug reports when viewing them through the docs interface!
